data.title: Contains Duplicate
data.description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.

examples.explanation: The value 1 appears at index 0 and 3.

hints: Try using a data structure that allows you to check if an element has been seen before in O(1) time.
A hash set (or hash table) can store elements you've already encountered while iterating through the array.
As you iterate through each element, check if it's already in your set. If it is, you've found a duplicate!
